description: Clone a public git repository and run feldspar-scan: OSV.dev advisories for pinned dependencies in lockfiles (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip/uv/poetry, Cargo, Go, Gemfile.lock), secret patterns with redacted evidence, and configuration lint. Returns a JSON report with summary counts and per-finding severity, file, line, advisory id and fixed versions. Deterministic, no LLM involved. Takes 2-90 s depending on repository size.

url.description: The repository URL only, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo (also gitlab.com, codeberg.org, bitbucket.org)

name: scan_repository
title: Scan a public repository
